testProvenance.modelStates: Three public-controller record-mode flows use actual PureModel steps and ordinary direction/A/B inputs. Each performs a shared-pan trial affecting at least two actual equations, a real B undo, and a complete all-six/all-three win. Cancel, same-tray free return, empty-history B, budget exhaustion and90-second timeout also use ordinary model inputs.
testProvenance.capacityFixtures: Five explicitly named capacity states extend moveBudget to30, then use ordinary model selection/pick/place inputs to collect all six physical instances into bank. Upper/lower selected/held and destination preview retain the genuine model integer totals/positions. This is geometry/legibility evidence, not authored-budget gameplay.
testProvenance.runtimeLayouts: Menu/start/pause use ordinary browser keys. Eleven state fixtures per viewport replace create only in a scratch HTTP response, copying the corresponding saved model state. There is no APK, encoded-video, physical-TV/phone or full browser-earned victory claim.
testProvenance.privacy: Deep-frozen state rendered without change. Every private field is replaced by a throwing getter and external clock/raw input changed; render commands/HUD/result remain identical.
testProvenance.history: Preliminary19-frame art and an incomplete acc670 pass remain scratch history. The latter exposed a budget-result orphan at960. The final5a0016 source was rerun completely; no early frame or source hash is relabelled as final.

independentStaticReview.scope: Read-only contract/source/icon review before final selection-box and result-copy corrections, no runtime claim.
resolvedFindings: Tagline no longer implies every tray individually influences all three equations.
Shared ASCII multiplication notation was explicitly accepted by root.
Final full-capacity browser images resolve the row-pitch versus selection-outline collision.

findings: Each physical tray and every weight instance is drawn once. Shared references retain explicit A/B/C IDs and matching colored inks.
Pan headers show actual grams; ledger totals and signed deltas show model integer weighted loads. ASCII2*A is clearly explained as the2:1 lever coefficient and does not duplicate a tray.

The corrected47px-high selection box leaves at least3 logical pixels between its stroke and the upper-row text bounds when the lower row is selected; both full-capacity upper/lower held screenshots are readable at960.
Held pickup stays in the source tray, with an explicit PENDING banner and destination-only outline. Source masses and equations do not preempt the commit.
Menu/pause/win/budget/timeout and the entire sidebar fit both viewports. Final short budget-loss result is single-line; no orphan result lines were detected.
